# Weft 1.1.25
- Web and desktop previews now share the same full-width frame and interaction. Desktop previews explain how to enable macOS window capture and retain the last frame while the app sleeps. - Agents can resume and release their own saved claims after chat compaction, using task-scoped context or a private receipt. Another task's claim stays protected. - Cursor, Codex, Claude and Grok Bot use the same claim resume mechanism. MCP responses keep raw claim credentials private, and shared HTTP connections never inherit the server's task context.
